summary: Formats a float elapsed-time value a1 into a "%s%02d:%02d" (prefix:MM:SS) string and submits it to the render context dword_7CD204 via ShortComputation_bde0 and TextLineWrappingAndRendering. When the prefix argument a2 is null it is replaced by the default string at byte_5EA438. The function formats and renders the text twice: first from v4 = a1 + 2.0 (both two-digit fields drawn from the same truncated value), then from v11 = a1 + 1.0 with the minute field computed as CRTFtol(v11 * 0.016666668) and the second field as CRTFtol(v11 - minutes * 60.0). Returns the result of the final TextLineWrappingAndRendering call. Called by PitTimer (0x004D2E50) for on-screen time display.

operations.description: If a2 is null, the prefix is replaced with the default string at byte_5EA438.
Computes v11 = a1 + 1.0, then v4 = v11 + 1.0 (i.e. a1 + 2.0); v11 is saved for the second format pass.
CRTFtol(v4) is evaluated twice into v5 and v6, truncating the float to integer for the first two-digit fields.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v10, "%s%02d:%02d", prefix, v5, v6) formats the prefix and two two-digit fields into the 128-byte buffer v10.
ShortComputation_bde0(&dword_7CD204, v10, 0) submits the formatted text to the render context at dword_7CD204.
Second pass: v9 = CRTFtol(v11 * 0.016666668) derives whole minutes; v7 = CRTFtol(v11 - (double)v9 * 60.0) derives remaining seconds.
StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v10, "%s%02d:%02d", prefix, v9, v7) reformats the buffer with the recomputed minutes and seconds.
Returns TextLineWrappingAndRendering(&dword_7CD204, (int)v10, 3, 16909060), rendering the wrapped text line with literal arguments 3 and 16909060.
